As a welder, you start your day by reviewing construction drawings and preparing materials. You cut and bend metal to size, assemble reinforcement using CO2 welding and carry out tack welding. You work accurately, as the quality of the final product depends on your precision. Together with your fellow welders, you discuss the planning and meet deadlines by working together and supporting each other.
